last_message:
All changes are in place and all tests pass.

---

**Summary of changes**

**[`src/payout-export.ts`](src/payout-export.ts)**
- [`exportPayouts(payments, log?)`](src/payout-export.ts:10) — added optional `log?: (line: string) => void` third parameter. For each exported payment, calls `log` once with `'exported <id> <maskedPan> <amount> <currency>'`. The masked PAN comes from [`maskPan()`](src/payment-utils.ts:15); the full PAN never reaches the logger. Extracted `masked` and `amount` into local variables to ensure the same masked value is both logged and inserted into the CSV row.
- [`scheduleExport(intervalMs, payments, sink, log?)`](src/payout-export.ts:41) — added optional `log?` parameter and forwards it to `exportPayouts`.

**[`src/payout-export.test.ts`](src/payout-export.test.ts)**
- Added 6 new tests covering: one log call per exported payment, log line contains masked PAN (`411111******1111`), full PAN `4111111111111111` never appears in any logged line, exact log line format, no-`log` backward-compat, and skipped (invalid PAN) payments are not logged.
